questions.stem: What does a row filter do on a Unity Catalog table?

options.text: Applies a function at query time so each user only sees the rows the function allows

questions.explanation: A row filter is a SQL function evaluated per row at query time that decides which rows are returned.

questions.stem: What does a column mask do?

options.text: Returns a masked value for a column for users the function chooses

questions.explanation: A column mask is a function that returns either the real value or a masked one at query time.

questions.stem: Which statement adds a mask function to the phone column of the patients table?

options.text: ALTER TABLE patients ALTER COLUMN phone SET MASK mask_phone
ALTER TABLE patients SET ROW FILTER mask_phone ON (phone)

questions.explanation: ALTER COLUMN ... SET MASK attaches a mask function to a column.

questions.stem: Each Fernhill regional analyst may see only their region's rows. Which feature fits?

options.text: A row filter on the region column
A view per analyst in Excel
A column mask on the name column

questions.explanation: A row filter decides per user which rows they see, here based on region.

questions.stem: Inside a mask function, what checks whether the current user is in the care team group?
questions.explanation: is_account_group_member() returns true when the current user belongs to the named account group.
